using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
struct Value
  std::optional<std::vector<std::uint8_t>> data
inline std::string encode(const Value& v)
inline Value decode(std::string_view data)
struct Store
  virtual Value read(const std::string& path)
  virtual void write(const std::string& path, const Value& base, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data)
